generation.typed_emission.title: Typed source-to-C emission
generation.typed_emission.reason: Complete the typed IR-to-C backend, configuration/state/step emission, failure mapping and generated/direct equivalence.

generation.provider_resolution.title: Pinned provider and dependency resolution
generation.provider_resolution.reason: Resolve actual operation subsets, versions/hashes, ABI/license/resource compatibility and requested evidence; metadata discovery alone is insufficient.

generation.resource_assignment.title: Exact target resource assignment
generation.resource_assignment.reason: Finish exact chip/package/board pin, clock, IRQ, DMA, trigger and intercore ownership assignment with conflicts and missing facts reported.

generation.memory_layout.title: Static memory and linker planning
generation.memory_layout.reason: Bound persistent/scratch/stack/DMA/GUI/network arenas and emit a compatible partition/linker plan with post-link checks.

generation.codec_generation.title: Typed protocol codec generation
generation.codec_generation.reason: Emit bounded encoders/decoders and reference vectors from the shared protocol schema; native C layout is not the wire format.

generation.build_profiles.title: Qualified source-to-image build profiles
generation.build_profiles.reason: Emit and validate matching startup, SDK, runtime configuration and reproducible toolchain/build inputs for an exact board.

generation.artifact_signing.title: Artifact verification and signing
generation.artifact_signing.reason: Bind image, compatibility manifest, signatures, trust and anti-rollback policy through vetted host signing providers.

generation.deployment.title: Discovery, programming and update
generation.deployment.reason: Complete read-only discovery and qualified exact-device programming/update with identity, recovery and verification.

generation.diagnostic_decoding.title: Build-bound diagnostics and blackbox decoding
generation.diagnostic_decoding.reason: Provide bounded schema/build-specific decoding and symbolization using the actual image/debug artifacts.

generation.manufacturing.title: Manufacturing and provisioning records
generation.manufacturing.reason: Bind serial/board identity, enrollment/calibration/test results and image provenance without leaking keys or inventing qualification.

generation.qualification.title: Generated acceptance and release evidence
generation.qualification.reason: Run generated/direct equivalence and host/target acceptance for the actual configuration; collect traceable results and enforce requested evidence gates.
